overall_conclusion: Do not treat the earlier generator file list as a fully verified from-zero reproduction bundle. Block artifacts and source identities match; sphere records match but the formal H5 is absent locally; MR3D adaptive scale calibration differs and needs a fixed-scale verified route.
verification_limits: No tetrahedral mesh generation or electromagnetic solve was run during this audit.
Block counts were independently read from existing H5 tetrahedron topology, with unique edges counted; real P1 DOFs equal twice the edge count.
Sphere and MR3D counts were verified through frozen metadata and actual production protocols/results; they were not independently recounted from the missing local formal H5 files.
The emg3d fixed mesh arrays alone were regenerated in memory and matched all frozen arrays and their hashes exactly.
H5 byte identity is separate from equality of coordinates, topology and material markers; a new filename or container metadata can change the file hash.

verification_method.artifacts: Streamed SHA256 over actual H5 and parameter files; matched mesh metadata and delivery manifests. Paper mesh metadata files matched the corresponding frozen original files byte for byte.
verification_method.source: Streamed/read actual current and frozen source files and compared SHA256; initial cross-validation parent archive source members were read without extraction.
verification_method.dimensions: h5py read actual mesh/topology and mesh/coordinates; enumerated and globally deduplicated all six edges per tetrahedron. For P1 first-kind Nedelec with the experiment natural boundary condition, complex DOF equals unique mesh edges and real DOF is twice that count.
verification_method.boundary: No mesh regeneration was performed; source provenance and original artifact identity/counts are verified, not byte-identical regeneration in the current environment.
